description: Z tag-and-probe of the lepton efficiencies (AN-16-442; fit conventions after efficiency_tnp_an): single-lepton-triggered tags, the AN loose lepton as the probe, sequential numerators ID, isolation (FSR-subtracted), SIP; pass and fail fitted simultaneously with the efficiency as a parameter.

extract.comment: Loose preselection of the compact tag-and-probe pairs: a pair is kept if at least one leg is a tag candidate on its raw quantities (the event fired a tag path of the leg's flavour, the leg is matched to an HLT object carrying a tag filter bit with trigger pT above trig_pt_min, and its raw pT is above pt_min, below the final tag thresholds to allow for the calibration); raw mass window

tag.comment: Final tag on the calibrated momenta, path-consistent: muons: HLT_IsoMu24 fired and matched with the Iso bit (2), or HLT_IsoTkMu24 fired and matched with the IsoTkMu bit (8), trigger-object pT >= 24, offline pT > 26 (plateau), |eta| < 2.4, POG tightId, pfRelIso04 < 0.15; electrons: HLT_Ele27_WPTight_Gsf fired with trigger-object pT >= 27, or HLT_Ele25_eta2p1_WPTight_Gsf with trigger-object pT >= 25 and |eta_SC| < 2.1, matched with the 1e WPTight bit (2), offline pT > 30, |eta_SC| < 2.1 outside 1.4442-1.566, cut-based tight (AN tag).

probe.comment: The AN loose lepton on the calibrated momenta (the skim floors carry |dxy| < 0.5 and |dz| < 1 cm): muons pT > 5 GeV, |eta| < 2.4, global or tracker with a matched station; electrons pT > 7 GeV, |eta| < 2.5.

steps.comment: Sequential numerators, each on the probes passing the previous ones: id (the analysis ID: PF muon; mvaFall17V2noIso WP90 until the stage-4b choice), iso (FSR-subtracted relative isolation < 0.35), sip (SIP3D < 4); full = id and iso and sip on the loose probes (cross-check of the product).

bins.comment: Probe pT (calibrated) and |eta| (muons abs(eta), electrons abs(eta_SC)) lower edges; terminal bins unbounded; (45 GeV, 1.2) lies at a bin centre for both flavours

histogram.comment: 0.5 GeV storage bins of the calibrated pair mass; the fit rebins to 1 GeV and coarsens (at most 3 GeV) to at least 40 entries per bin

fit.comment: After efficiency_tnp_an: window 60-120 GeV, rebinned to the narrowest of 1-3 GeV with >= 40 entries per bin; a category with fewer than min_category_entries raw entries is counting only
